stations.name: Five Points

levels.name: B1 upper: east-west

layout.value: combined: centre island between the two tracks plus one side platform outside each track (Spanish solution)
layout.note: Centre platform: MARTA RAC update names a centre platform on each level. All three platforms: Wikipedia and nycsubway.org on both levels; MARTA section render shows the arrangement end-on for the lower level. Wikipedia: island doors on the left, side doors on the right.

osm_measured.note: One OSM polygon covers each whole level; it is not a per-platform outline and its length is shorter than the system figure.

design.note: System-wide figure from a secondary source, not a per-station survey. Bankhead, which is not in this table, is shorter.

platform_width_m.note: Bounding width of the OSM polygon(s). Mapped widths are rough, especially under ground.

depth_m.note: Track bed in the open cuts on both sides (Gulch 310.4-313.0 m, east cut 310.9-311.4 m NAVD88) against bare ground at the station (320.5-323.8 m). Assumes the track is near level between the cuts.
depth_m.datum: track bed below the bare ground at the station

levels.level_description: Below the concourse; the upper of the two platform levels.

platforms.role: whole platform level (centre and both side platforms)

levels.name: B2 lower: north-south

layout.value: combined: centre island between the two tracks plus one side platform outside each track (Spanish solution)
layout.note: Centre platform: MARTA RAC update names a centre platform on each level. All three platforms: Wikipedia and nycsubway.org on both levels; MARTA section render shows the arrangement end-on for the lower level. Wikipedia: island doors on the left, side doors on the right.

depth_m.note: No published figure. One level below the east-west platforms.

levels.level_description: Below the east-west level; crosses it at about right angles.

platforms.role: whole platform level (centre and both side platforms)

notes: Sam's recollection is confirmed: both levels have a centre platform and two side platforms.

Wikipedia calls the east-west level "at-grade below the intersecting elevated street viaducts"; OSM maps it as tunnel=yes, location=underground, and docs/data-model.md says underground. Both fit a level at old rail grade, roofed by streets and plaza.
Non-revenue interline ways (1453238811, 1453238820) pass the station and are not counted.
Way 428067988 is tagged layer=-2 but level=2, apparently a tagging slip.

depth_m.note: MARTA profile: platform 120 ft beneath Peachtree Street. The 1978 MARTA paper says the rock tunnel is 115 ft (35.1 m) below the surface "at the deepest point".

levels.level_description: Street, mezzanine, platform. Rock cavern in gneiss; deepest MARTA station.

notes: The OSM platform (centre 33.7595) is about 150 m north of both GTFS stop points (33.7581). Station entrances in OSM run from 33.7579 to 33.7607, so the platform lies between them. The platform position has no independent survey.
The mezzanine poster quotes a 900 ft station length. That is the station, not the platform.
